[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: cover procedural cube/plane/cone/cylinder/sphere counts, bounds, normals and UVs

impact_assessment.why: Procedural primitives feed the shooter's meshes but had no direct testbed coverage of their topology, winding, radial normals or UV ranges.
impact_assessment.benefits: Five tests pin cube face winding, plane UVs, cone/cylinder side and cap normals, sphere radial normals and all primitive bounds/argument guards.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: in-memory meshes only; no game/sim/hash change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Small segment counts, full suite, determinism and project gates.
